tip: Force the use of IPv4 addresses only.
Force the use of IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: -c
tip: Specify a certificate file to identify sshd during key exchange.
The certificate must match a host key from -h or HostKey.

option.name: -C
tip: Specify connection parameters for -T extended test mode.
Supply keyword=value pairs separated by commas or with multiple -C options.
Keywords: addr, user, host, laddr, lport, rdomain; the invalid-user flag takes no value.

option.name: -d
tip: Debug mode.
Send verbose debug output to stderr, do not fork, and handle one connection.
May be repeated up to 3 times.

option.name: -D
tip: Do not detach; stay in the foreground.
This allows easy monitoring of sshd.

option.name: -e
tip: Write debug logs to standard error instead of the system log.

option.name: -E
tip: Append debug logs to the given file instead of the system log.

option.name: -f
tip: Specify the configuration file.
sshd refuses to start if there is no configuration file.

option.name: -g
tip: Set the grace time for client authentication (default 120 seconds).
A value of zero means no limit.

option.name: -G
tip: Parse the configuration, print the effective configuration to stdout and exit.
Match rules may be applied with -C.

option.name: -h
tip: Specify a host key file.
Required when sshd does not run as root; multiple host keys may be given.

option.name: -i
tip: Indicate that sshd is run from inetd.

option.name: -o
tip: Give options in the configuration-file format.
Useful for options without a separate command-line flag.
See sshd_config(5) for the options and their values.

option.name: -p
tip: Specify the port on which the server listens (default 22).
Multiple port options are permitted.

option.name: -q
tip: Quiet mode.
Nothing is sent to the system log.

option.name: -t
tip: Test mode.
Only check the validity of the configuration file and the sanity of the keys.

option.name: -T
tip: Extended test mode.
Check the configuration and print the effective configuration, including the tests performed by -t.

option.name: -u
tip: Set the size of the utmp field that holds the remote host name.
If the name is longer, the dotted decimal address is used instead.
-u0 stores only dotted decimal addresses and avoids DNS lookups.

option.name: -V
tip: Display the version number and exit.
